original_target.title: Determine a smooth sound-soft obstacle from one far-field pattern

scope_comparison: Liimatainen–Lin–Ola Theorem1.2 is a PLANAR interior boundary problem and permits its single Dirichlet datum to depend on both configurations; Remark1.4 states this explicitly. This does not establish uniqueness in R3 for a prescribed fixed-frequency incident plane wave on every smooth obstacle. Colbrook Pompeiu–Schiffer overdetermined eigenfunction result is a different statement.
